:::{#thm-canonical-link-inverse}
#### The canonical link inverts $b'$

In an exponential dispersion family (@def-natural-parameter)
that satisfies the conditions of @thm-edf-mean-variance,
with $b''(\theta) > 0$ for every $\theta$,
the canonical link is the inverse of $b'$:

$$
g(\mu) = \invf{b'}(\mu)
$$
:::
